We are hiring a PhD candidate at Utrecht University!

Are you interested in developing new machine learning methods for a challenging real-world application? This PhD project focuses on hybrid / process-informed machine learning for global soil mapping.

The goal is to develop next-generation methods for geospatial prediction by integrating scientific process knowledge into modern AI approaches. The research will explore methods such as neural networks, tabular transformers, and Bayesian approaches, with applications to large-scale spatiotemporal and environmental data.

We are particularly interested in candidates with a strong quantitative background, for example in data science, machine learning, statistics, applied mathematics, computational geosciences, or related fields, who enjoy working on interdisciplinary problems and have programming experience in Python, JS, and/or R.
